item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I found no solid evidence that Putin in 2023 built fair, predictable rules for competition or investment. The limited positive material is mostly technocratic resistance to the most arbitrary seizures and pro-investment rhetoric. The stronger pattern is politicized ownership rules, retaliation against foreign firms, and pressure on business to serve the state.","evidence":[{"title":"Putin urges business leaders to build new Russian economy","publisher":"Reuters","date":"16 Mar 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/putin-urges-business-leaders-to-build-new-russian-economy-3032308","summary":"Weak pro-side evidence: Putin urged business elites to invest in new technology, production facilities, and enterprises. That is broad evidence of precarious, politicized property rights.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.2","5B.3"]}]}
